description: This file contains the implementation of the EventHubAdapterReceiver class, which manages receiving messages from Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes configuration settings, initialization, message retrieval, cache management, and shutdown procedures, along with internal classes and logging for monitoring.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionSettings
classes.description: Configuration class for Event Hub partition settings, including hub options, receiver options, and partition name.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Main class implementing message reception, caching, and lifecycle management for Event Hub partitions within Orleans.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterReceiver.StreamActivityNotificationBatch
classes.description: Internal class representing a batch notification for stream activity, implementing IBatchContainer.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterReceiver.Cursor
classes.description: Internal class implementing IQueueCacheCursor to iterate over cached messages.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver, setting up cache and connection to Event Hub.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves messages from Event Hub, converts them into batches, and updates checkpointer.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, closing connections and disposing resources.

methods.name: ConfigureDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Configures data generator for testing purposes on a specific stream.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production on a specific stream for testing.
